name: research-entity
description:
Board-ready competitive-intelligence and due-diligence dossiers on any legal entity — company, startup, or vendor. 23-section report: executive briefing (BLUF, scorecard, SWOT, threat heat map, strategic playbook, monitoring watchlist), founders, funding, product and technical architecture, pricing, customers, competition, community reception, security posture, and an 8-pattern red-flag risk scan. Every datapoint cross-validated against multiple free public sources, hallucination-audited, mermaid render-validated, with HTML/PDF/battle-card/VC-memo export.

Drop in a company name: the skill gathers evidence from free public sources, cross-validates every datapoint, labels aggregator-only data, and outputs a structured Markdown dossier with a confidence-and-methodology appendix.

Try asking:
/research-entity "Stripe"
/research-entity "Acme Corp" --type=due-diligence --audience=investor --depth=deep --export=both
/research-entity "DevTool X" --vertical=devtools --data-sources=github,linkedin --audit=tech-stack
/research-entity "Acme Corp" --year-over-year
/research-entity "Acme Corp" --export=battle-card

23 sections · 9 vertical templates · 7 stage templates · 4 focused audits · 5 analytic frameworks + 7 Powers moat scoring.
